name: Simple Homemade Chicken Ramen
desc: Crisp-skinned roasted chicken breast and a soft-boiled egg over ramen noodles in a quick ginger, soy, and shiitake broth.

source.title: Simple Homemade Chicken Ramen
source.evidence: Same title and identical ingredient list and amounts (2 boneless skin-on breasts, 3 tbsp low-sodium soy, 2 tbsp mirin, 4 cups rich stock, 1 oz dried shiitake, 2 packs of ramen) and the same sear-then-roast chicken at 375°F.

ingredients.raw: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, for seasoning the chicken
2 tsp toasted sesame oil or vegetable oil
ingredients.item: toasted sesame oil or vegetable oil

ingredients.raw: 1 oz dried shiitake mushrooms (or 1/2 cup sliced fresh)
1 to 2 tsp fine sea salt, to taste
2 large eggs, straight from the fridge
2 (3 oz) packs dried ramen noodles (seasoning packets discarded)
1 jalapeño or fresh red chili, thinly sliced, optional

steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Season the chicken all over with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken skin side down and cook until the skin is golden and releases easily, 5-7 min. Flip and cook 4-5 min more.
Move the skillet to the oven and roast until the thickest part reads 165°F, 15-20 min. Transfer to a plate and tent with foil.
Broth: heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat until shimmering. Add the ginger and garlic and cook until softened and fragrant, 1-2 min. Stir in the soy sauce and mirin and cook 1 min.
Add the stock, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover and simmer 5 min, then add the mushrooms and simmer gently 10 min more. Season with sea salt to taste.

Eggs: bring a pot of water to a boil and fill a bowl with ice water. Lower the cold eggs into the boiling water and simmer 7 min for a slightly runny yolk (8 min for soft but set). Move them to the ice bath for at least 5 min, then peel and halve lengthwise.
Bring the egg water back to a boil and cook the noodles until soft, 2-3 min. Drain.
Slice the chicken. Divide the noodles between two large bowls, add the chicken, and ladle in the broth. Top with the egg halves, scallions, and chili.
